promotions.behavior: trap lifecycle state is centrally owned and validated
assumptions: Reforged requires deterministic ownership even where Classic persistence remains unresolved
tests: --smoke-traps detects, disarms, rearms, triggers, consumes charges, and validates invariants
promotions.safeFallback: missing or invalid trap state is rejected or restored to catalog defaults
promotions.characterSaveImpact: none; character abilities and protection values are read-only inputs
promotions.worldStateImpact: armed, revealed, charges, rearm deadline, reset deadline, and revision may persist when configured

promotions.behavior: trap effects are emitted as typed requests to owning subsystems
assumptions: trap lifecycle owns activation while Combat, Spells, NPC AI, Doors, and Quests own final mutations
tests: --smoke-traps verifies damage, status, and alarm requests without duplicating effect resolution
promotions.safeFallback: unknown or absent effect request IDs produce no invented effect
promotions.characterSaveImpact: downstream only; no direct trap mutation of character saves
promotions.worldStateImpact: downstream requests may mutate their owner subsystem after validation

promotions.behavior: detection and disarm require explicit abilities and evidence-only score thresholds
assumptions: ability gating is active; exact native random formulas remain unresolved
tests: --smoke-traps verifies ability gating and threshold outcomes
promotions.safeFallback: deny detection or disarm when ability or threshold evidence is insufficient
promotions.runtimeImpact: activates safe trap-interaction policy without inventing native random arithmetic
promotions.worldStateImpact: successful detection reveals; successful disarm changes armed and rearm state
